findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (57.59 yds from volume vs 55.65 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We OVER-project attempts by 0.8 per player (projected 29.49, actual 28.69).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.11 (projected 7.13, actual 7.23).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 78.94, without it 77.4. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 12/35 (34.29%). Our MAE 78.94 vs the line's 71.73. The book is the better projection.
